title: Kyle W Probable NDE 6873
content: Before the experience, I had been huffing gas regularly for one year. After my first near death experience in 2010, I quit for three months. I picked up the habit again and finally I had another near death experience. I then quit for a whole year in 2011. I had two more and finally quit for good in 2013. During the first experience, I found myself slowly drifting out of consciousness until I was completely in a void of darkness. I had no sense of time or space. I watched as a bright light came out of the darkness toward me. I joined with the light. Then I became conscious and found myself on the ground. The second near death experience built upon the first. This time, after I had joined with the light, I noticed how everything came to be. There was nothing in the void. All of a sudden, the light was created from the void. Then I came back to consciousness, lying in my bed, and not knowing how I had got there. The third experience built upon the other two. I found myself alone in the darkness. I was the one particle of light in the void. I became lonely and bored, so I split myself into two parts. Then I split into four parts, then eight parts, and then sixteen parts. I kept doubling myself, repeatedly, until I became everything and everyone. I came back to consciousness from being passed out in the driveway. The fourth and final time I had passed out on one side of my body. I was still awake on the other half. I was dead but awake. My vision on one side had been turned to the void. I could think on one side of my brain but was dead on the other side. I physically walked through the door of the house on one side, but on the other side of my body, I felt as if though I had traveled through space and time. I felt that I would never be able to return to my body. Then the live half of me took over the void. I became one again. I was dead but alive at the same time. Later, I tried to commit suicide. Everything went black. No light had appeared. There was pure darkness. I came back to consciousness two days later at home. I did not know what had happened before or after I tried to commit suicide. Apparently, I was awake and talking to people. I don't remember anything like that happening. I don't remember any events that happened two days prior or after.

environment.environment_other_detail: Void/darkness; bright light emerged/was created from the void.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Huffing gas/solvent inhalation leading to passing out; later a suicide attempt with blackout.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Repeated experiences described as: drifting out of consciousness → void/darkness → bright light appears/joins with light → return to consciousness; later suicide attempt described as blackness with no light.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Third and fourth experiences emphasize being/containing the light within the void and splitting into many parts; fourth includes a half-body 'dead but awake' state and feeling of traveling through space/time on one side.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Four NDE-like episodes with similar void/light/return pattern; plus a later suicide attempt with only darkness and no light.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Fourth episode described being 'dead but alive at the same time' and having one side in the void while the other side was awake/functional.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Third experience: experiencer identifies as the single particle of light in the void and repeatedly splits into more parts until becoming 'everything and everyone.' Fourth: half-body split state (one side dead/void, one side alive) with simultaneous walking physically and feeling of traveling through space/time.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was dead but awake.” “I was the one particle of light in the void.” “I kept doubling myself, repeatedly, until I became everything and everyone.”
